result.title: Exploring Attention Sinks in Text-to-Image Transformers from Diffusion and Autoregressive Models
result.summary: Attention sinks are tokens or positions that consistently receive disproportionate attention mass, often beyond what their semantic content would suggest. Despite extensive study in large language models, their behavior and functional relevance in text-to-image (T2I) Transformers remain largely unexplored. To fill this gap and better understand how text-to-image Transformers allocate and route attention, we explore this phenomenon of text-to-image transformers across bidirectional diffusion models and causal autoregressive models. Specifically, we explore whether attention sinks exist, where they emerge, and how they functionally influence generation. Through systematic attention analysis and targeted interventions, we identify that attention sinks emerge in both bidirectional diffusion and autoregressive models but exhibit distinct patterns. The autoregressive model concentrates attention on the first and global-scale tokens, whereas the bidirectional models develop sinks near modality boundaries, within text regions, and at spatial corners. Moreover, these patterns vary across generation stages and are localized to a sparse subset of layers and heads. To assess their functional relevance, we perturb sink-related heads and token positions. It turns out that perturbing sink-ranked heads produces larger average changes than non-sink comparisons, while some sink-position perturbations have limited effects on bidirectional model scores. We further introduce register tokens to redistribute attention sinks and find that several configurations preserve or modestly improve generation performance. Overall, attention sinks are architecture-, inference-stage-, and component-dependent phenomena, providing a basis for mechanistic analysis and principled attention design in text-to-image transformers.

AI.brief_summary: 论文系统考察 text-to-image Transformer 中的 attention sink 现象：在双向 diffusion 与因果 autoregressive 模型中定位 sink 出现的位置、跨生成阶段的分布及集中的少数层与头，并通过扰动 sink 相关头与 token 位置、引入 register token 重分配注意力，检验其功能作用。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「定位注意力 sink 再施加干预以判断功能重要性」的分析流程，可能可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据如何被注意力路由、哪些头或位置对推理状态有真实因果贡献；但研究对象是图像生成而非多模态推理，迁移线索需人工验证。
